about.title: About OpenLyst
about.subtitle: We are a collective of developers, designers, and enthusiasts building free and open source applications that serve the people, not corporate interests.
about.missionDesc: Technology should liberate, not exploit. We build software that empowers users and respects their freedom.
about.powerDesc: In a world where technology increasingly serves corporate interests and surveillance capitalism, we stand for digital freedom. Every application we build is designed to give users complete control over their data, their experience, and their digital life.
about.noTracking: No tracking, no surveillance, no data collection
about.transparentDev: Transparent development and open source code
about.quoteAudre: "The master's tools will never dismantle the master's house. They may allow us temporarily to beat him at his own game, but they will never enable us to bring about genuine change."
about.quoteNote: We believe that to create truly free software, we must build new tools with fresh principles from the ground up, not just replicate existing exploitative systems.
about.valuesDesc: These principles guide everything we do, from code design to community interaction.
about.privacyFirstDesc: User privacy is not negotiable. We build applications that respect and protect user data by design.
about.communityDrivenDesc: Our software is built by the community, for the community. Every voice matters in our development process.
about.transparencyDesc: All our code is open source. Our development process is transparent and our decisions are made in the open.
about.accessibilityDesc: Software should be usable by everyone. We prioritize accessibility and inclusive design in all our applications.
about.performanceDesc: We believe good software should be fast, efficient, and respectful of system resources.
about.sustainabilityDesc: We build software for the long term, with sustainable development practices and minimal environmental impact.
about.ourStoryDesc: How OpenLyst started and where it is today.
about.beginningDesc: OpenLyst started as a small group of developers frustrated with proprietary software and looking for practical open alternatives.
about.growingDesc: What started as personal projects grew into a collaborative effort with contributors from around the world.
about.revolutionaryDesc: OpenLyst is now a contributor-led project used by thousands of people.
about.collectiveDesc: Meet some of the contributors behind OpenLyst.
about.coreDevelopersSubtitle: The backbone of our development team
about.coreDevelopersDesc: Writing code, fixing bugs, and architecting the future
about.designersDesc: Making complex software simple and intuitive
about.securityExpertsDesc: Auditing code and implementing security best practices
about.documentationTeamSubtitle: Making our software accessible to everyone
about.documentationTeamDesc: Writing guides, tutorials, and API documentation
about.translatorsDesc: Localizing our applications for global accessibility
about.communityTeamDesc: Moderating forums, answering questions, and fostering community
about.joinCollective: Want to join our collective? We're always looking for passionate people who share our values.

contribute.title: Get Involved
contribute.subtitle: Help us build free and open-source applications. Every contribution counts.
contribute.waysDesc: There are many ways to support our mission, regardless of your technical background.
contribute.codeDevDesc: Contribute to our applications with new features, bug fixes, and improvements.
contribute.designDesc: Help create accessible and easy-to-use interfaces.
contribute.docDesc: Help make our software accessible through clear documentation and guides.
contribute.translationDesc: Help make our applications accessible to users around the world.
contribute.testingDesc: Help ensure our applications work perfectly across all platforms and use cases.
contribute.communitySupportDesc: Help other users get the most out of our applications and build our community.
contribute.gettingStartedDesc: Ready to contribute? Here's how to get involved with the OpenLyst community.
contribute.step1Desc: Start by joining our Matrix chat room where contributors coordinate, share ideas, and help each other.
contribute.step2Desc: Browse our issue trackers for beginner-friendly tasks marked with "good first issue" or "help wanted" labels.
contribute.step3Desc: Familiarize yourself with our contribution guidelines, code of conduct, and development practices.
contribute.step4Desc: Start with a small contribution to get familiar with our workflow. Even fixing typos helps!
contribute.resourcesDesc: Everything you need to become an effective OpenLyst contributor.
contribute.developerDocsDesc: Setup guides, API docs, and architecture overview
contribute.sourceCodeDesc: All our repositories on GitHub and GitLab
contribute.codeOfConductDesc: We are committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive environment for all contributors.
contribute.safeSpaceDesc: OpenLyst is committed to fostering an inclusive, welcoming community. Our Code of Conduct ensures that everyone feels safe to contribute, regardless of their background, experience level, or identity.
contribute.focusingOnCommunity: Focusing on what's best for the community
contribute.inappropriateConduct: Other conduct inappropriate in a professional setting
contribute.readyToMakeDifferenceDesc: Join contributors building practical free software.
contribute.meadQuote: "Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world; indeed, it's the only thing that ever has."

api.pageDescription: Free API documentation for accessing OpenLyst repository data
api.title: OpenLyst API
api.subtitle: Access OpenLyst app and release data programmatically. Free to use, no authentication required.
api.baseUrlSubtitle: All API requests should be made to this URL
api.howItWorksSubtitle: Response format, parameters, and error codes
api.responseFormatDesc: Successful responses are JSON with success: true, a data field (array or object), and often language and count. Add ?lang=en|zh|ru to any request for localized strings (default: en).
api.langParamDesc: Optional. Localized content: en, zh, or ru.
api.quickStartSubtitle: Get started with a simple example
api.apiEndpointsSubtitle: Complete reference for all available endpoints
api.downloadsFieldDesc: The downloads field in version objects contains platform-specific download URLs. Different platforms support different installer types and architectures.
api.tempDownloadsOffDesc: The repo endpoint (GET /api/v1/repo) may include tempDownloadsOff: true. When true, clients should hide or disable download UI and show an appropriate message (e.g. that hosted builds are temporarily unavailable).
api.windowsDownloadsDesc: Windows supports multiple installer types and package managers.
api.linuxDownloadsDesc: Linux supports various package formats and package managers.
api.androidDownloadsDesc: Android supports APK and AAB formats.
api.exeDesc: NSIS, Inno Setup, or other installers
api.notFoundDesc: Returned when the requested resource doesn't exist.
api.badRequestDesc: Returned when required parameters are missing.
api.serverErrorDesc: Returned when an internal error occurs.
api.successDesc: All successful responses include success: true.
api.noRateLimitsDesc: Currently no rate limits are enforced. Please use responsibly.
api.noApiKeyDesc: No authentication or API keys required to access any endpoint.
api.openSourceDesc: This API is part of the OpenLyst open source project.
api.cacheResponses: Cache responses when possible to reduce server load
api.useSpecificEndpoints: Use specific endpoints instead of fetching all data repeatedly
api.includeUserAgent: Include a User-Agent header identifying your application
api.dontMakeExcessiveRequests: Don't make excessive requests in short time periods
